dedupe_keys.name: instance data for scheduling trucks on factory premises

description: Simon Emde publishes 54 benchmark instances for scheduling trucks across dock doors on factory premises. The August 2021 deposit contains eighteen small, eighteen medium and eighteen large text files under CC BY 4.0. The public description defines truck and door counts, required visits, processing-time matrices, door distances, arrival-release times, due dates and objective weights. Factory length is specified in metres, with generated timing distributions recorded per instance. These freely downloadable inputs support comparison of factory-logistics scheduling and discrete-event simulation methods. They represent constructed cases, not an identified operating site, and transferability to real yard constraints remains uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly includes the instances. Files were not downloaded, so matrix consistency, time units and previously reported algorithm results were not independently checked.
